summary.name: FindAIforWork
summary.one_liner: FindAIforWork is a human-reviewed directory of AI productivity tools organized by work scenario, where product makers can list their tools for free or with paid Basic and Pro placements.
use_cases: Finding AI productivity tools for a specific work task
Submitting an AI product to a directory
Getting a dofollow backlink from a product listing
Connecting an AI assistant to a directory via MCP
Comparing free and paid directory listing options
summary.what_it_does: The page is mainly a listing policy for product makers rather than a description of the tools themselves. It describes a free listing ($0.00) that requires adding a backlink to FindAIforWork on the product's homepage, verifying it, and getting human approval. Paid Basic ($9.90 one-time) and Pro ($29.90 one-time) listings are described with dofollow links to the product website, with Pro adding Featured placements, a badge, and homepage rotation for 30 days. Listings can be edited in a Dashboard, and edits go through review. Per the directory listing, it is a human-reviewed directory organized by work scenario that offers a free read-only remote MCP server.
notable: Human-reviewed directory organized by work scenario
Free read-only remote MCP server (per directory listing)
Free listing requires a homepage backlink; Basic and Pro paid listings do not
caveats: Paid Basic ($9.90) and Pro ($29.90) listings are one-time payments; Pro Featured placement lasts 30 days from plan start
Free listings need backlink verification and human approval before appearing
No guarantee of domain rating, rankings, traffic or other SEO results
